containerVersion.name: WorkDesk website tracking v2
containerVersion.description: GA4, Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, Google Ads and Microsoft Clarity for the WorkDesk website. Real-traffic filter, consent mode v2 defaults, internal traffic kept out, page content groups, leads counted only on confirmed form submission, every CTA, menu, tab, FAQ, calculator and scroll depth.

tag.name: Consent - Defaults (consent mode v2)

parameter.value:
<script>
  // Consent mode v2 defaults. The site has no cookie banner yet, so:
  // EEA, UK and Switzerland: storage off (GA4 sends cookieless pings only, which is what the law there expects without consent).
  // Everywhere else, including Pakistan: analytics on.
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  function gtag(){ dataLayer.push(arguments); }
  gtag('consent', 'default', {
    ad_storage: 'denied', ad_user_data: 'denied', ad_personalization: 'denied', analytics_storage: 'denied',
    region: ['AT','BE','BG','HR','CY','CZ','DK','EE','FI','FR','DE','GR','HU','IS','IE','IT','LV','LI','LT','LU','MT','NL','NO','PL','PT','RO','SK','SI','ES','SE','GB','CH'],
    wait_for_update: 500
  });
  gtag('consent', 'default', {
    ad_storage: 'granted', ad_user_data: 'granted', ad_personalization: 'granted', analytics_storage: 'granted',
    functionality_storage: 'granted', security_storage: 'granted'
  });
  gtag('set', 'ads_data_redaction', true);
</script>

tag.notes: Runs before everything else. If you add a cookie banner later, replace this with the banner's own GTM template.

tag.name: Util - Mark internal visitors (wd_internal cookie)

parameter.value:
<script>
  // Visit any page with ?wd_internal=1 once on each browser your team uses; ?wd_internal=0 removes the mark.
  (function () {
    var m = /[?&]wd_internal=(1|0)(&|$)/.exec(location.search);
    if (!m) return;
    var secure = location.protocol === 'https:' ? '; Secure' : '';
    document.cookie = m[1] === '1'
      ? 'wd_internal=1; path=/; max-age=31536000; SameSite=Lax' + secure
      : 'wd_internal=; path=/; max-age=0; SameSite=Lax' + secure;
  })();
</script>

tag.notes: Sets a first-party cookie so your own visits carry traffic_type=internal and can be filtered out in GA4.

tag.name: GA4 - Google tag
tag.notes: Sends the page_view (once per page load) and the content group: Home, Product, Solutions, Pricing, Conversion, Company, Blog, Support, Legal, Error.

tag.name: GA4 - generate_lead
tag.notes: KEY EVENT. Fires only after the form server confirms it received the form (demo, contact, partner, affiliate, careers, signup). Mark generate_lead as a key event in GA4.

tag.name: GA4 - lead_form_start
tag.notes: First time a visitor types in or clicks into a lead form on this page view. Once per form per page.

tag.name: GA4 - lead_form_error
tag.notes: A submit that did not become a lead. error_type: missing_fields, invalid_email, not_connected (no form endpoint set on the site), send_failed (server error).

tag.name: GA4 - cta_click
tag.notes: Every button and text link CTA. cta_type: book_demo, sign_up, log_in, pricing, contact, affiliate_apply, feature_page and more. cta_location: header, hero, cta_band, pricing_builder, footer or the section name.

tag.name: GA4 - navigation_click
tag.notes: Menu, footer, breadcrumb, logo and in-article links. nav_area: header, header_menu, mobile_menu, footer, breadcrumb, content.

tag.name: GA4 - contact_click
tag.notes: Email, phone and WhatsApp links. contact_method: email, phone, whatsapp.

tag.name: GA4 - quote_click
tag.notes: Get my quote on the pricing page, with the modules and headcount the visitor picked.

tag.name: GA4 - pricing_configure
tag.notes: Pricing builder settled for 1.5 s after a change (no event per slider tick).

tag.name: GA4 - calculator_use
tag.notes: Affiliate commission calculator settled for 1.5 s after a change.

tag.name: GA4 - faq_open
tag.notes: A question opened on the FAQ, help, pricing or feature pages. Closing sends nothing.

tag.name: GA4 - tab_select
tag.notes: Role tabs (Solutions), profile tabs (People), plan switch (affiliate calculator) and chart filters (Reports).

tag.name: GA4 - interactive_demo
tag.notes: Clicks on the live product demos on the site: leave_approval, report_export.

tag.name: GA4 - menu_open
tag.notes: Header mega menus and the mobile menu opened.

tag.name: GA4 - page_not_found
tag.notes: A visitor reached the 404 page. Use it to find and fix broken links.

tag.name: GA4 - scroll_depth
tag.notes: Scroll depth 25, 50, 75%, once each per page, only after a real scroll. GA4 enhanced measurement adds "scroll" at 90%.

tag.name: Meta - Lead

parameter.value:
<script>
  if (window.fbq) fbq('track', 'Lead', { content_name: {{DLV - form_name}}, content_category: 'website form' });
</script>

tag.notes: Demo, contact and signup forms accepted by the server. Optimise lead campaigns for this.

tag.name: Meta - SubmitApplication
tag.notes: Partner and affiliate applications, kept separate so customer campaigns are not optimised for partners.

tag.name: Meta - CustomizeProduct (quote)

parameter.value:
<script>
  if (window.fbq) fbq('track', 'CustomizeProduct', { content_name: 'pricing quote', num_items: {{DLV - module_count}} });
</script>

tag.notes: Get my quote on the pricing page.

tag.name: TikTok - SubmitForm (lead)
tag.notes: Demo, contact and signup forms accepted by the server. Optimise lead campaigns for this.

tag.name: Google Ads - Google tag (audiences)
tag.notes: Builds remarketing audiences from real visitors. Fires only once "Const - Google Ads ID" is filled in.

tag.name: Google Ads - Conversion Linker
tag.notes: Stores the ad click ID so a lead can be credited to the ad that brought the visitor.

tag.name: Google Ads - Lead conversion
tag.notes: Demo, contact and signup forms accepted by the server. Fires only once both Google Ads constants are filled in.

tag.name: Clarity - Load

parameter.value:
<script>
  // Microsoft Clarity. Does nothing until "Const - Clarity Project ID" holds a real ID.
  (function () {
    var id = String({{Const - Clarity Project ID}});
    if (!/^[a-z0-9]{6,15}$/.test(id)) return;
    (function(c,l,a,r,i,t,y){
      c[a]=c[a]||function(){(c[a].q=c[a].q||[]).push(arguments)};
      t=l.createElement(r);t.async=1;t.src="https://www.clarity.ms/tag/"+i;
      y=l.getElementsByTagName(r)[0];y.parentNode.insertBefore(t,y);
    })(window, document, "clarity", "script", id);
    var g = {{DLV - content_group}};
    if (g) window.clarity('set', 'content_group', g);
  })();
</script>

tag.notes: Heatmaps and session recordings of real visitors, tagged with the page content group.

tag.name: Clarity - Tag key moments

parameter.value:
<script>
  // Lets you filter Clarity recordings by what happened: generate_lead, lead_form_error, quote_click, calculator_use, page_not_found.
  if (window.clarity) {
    window.clarity('event', {{Event}});
    if ({{Event}} === 'generate_lead') { window.clarity('set', 'lead_form', {{DLV - form_name}}); window.clarity('upgrade', 'lead'); }
    if ({{Event}} === 'lead_form_error') window.clarity('set', 'form_error', {{DLV - error_type}});
  }
</script>

tag.notes: "upgrade" keeps every recording that ends in a lead.

variable.name: Const - GA4 Measurement ID
variable.notes: REPLACE with your GA4 Measurement ID (GA4 Admin > Data streams > your web stream).

variable.name: Const - Allowed hostnames regex
variable.notes: Set to your live domain so test copies (Vercel, Hostinger temporary domain, GitHub Pages) never count. Example: ^(www\.)?workdesk\.pk$

variable.name: JS - Is real traffic
variable.notes: Every GA4 tag fires only when this is true. Edit the hostname constant rather than this code.

variable.name: DLV - form_name
variable.notes: demo, contact, partner, affiliate, careers, signup

variable.name: Const - Meta Pixel ID
variable.notes: Meta Events Manager > Data sources > your pixel > Settings. Numbers only, e.g. 1234567890123456.

variable.name: Const - TikTok Pixel ID
variable.notes: TikTok Ads Manager > Tools > Events > Web events > your pixel. Looks like CABCD1234EFGH5678IJK.

variable.name: Const - Clarity Project ID
variable.notes: clarity.microsoft.com > your project > Settings > Overview. About 10 lowercase letters and numbers.

variable.name: Const - Google Ads ID
variable.notes: Google Ads > Goals > Conversions > your lead conversion > Tag setup > Use Google Tag Manager: the Conversion ID, numbers only (no "AW-").

variable.name: Const - Google Ads lead label
variable.notes: Same screen as the Conversion ID: the Conversion label, e.g. AbC-D_efG-h12_34-567.
